conclusion_assessment.summary: RGB and LEXSET reach similar test accuracy (97.83333% and97.91667%), both higher than MNIST88.38539%. RGB uses10490 training images versus LEXSET21600 and MNIST27455. The paper strict RGB-best ranking is not reproduced: LEXSET is0.08333 percentage points higher in this single-seed reconstruction. Similar RGB performance with fewer training examples is retained descriptively; absolute paper test scores are not recovered.

limits: Different datasets and test samples; this is not a controlled causal comparison of representations or evidence of statistically reliable superiority from the0.08333pp difference.
